question: What lineage-centered blessings and paradoxical attribute are ascribed to the goddess?
premises: The goddess is the family liṅga.
The goddess is the bliss of the family.
The goddess is the delight of the family.
inference: She is the sacred emblem and joy of the lineage while also bearing the paradoxical attribute of false reasoning.
